messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=latency-watch-eu (policy=p95>300ms). Alert: 5m p95=380ms, p99=2.1s, SLO burn 12% (last 5m). Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-321
oncall-uk: acked. I'm on it, starting triage. :wave:
maria_sre: saw the spike on dashboard — high tail coming from tokenizer sidecar in eu-west-1. KV-cache eviction rate spiked ~10x.
jaxon-eng: noted. Any recent deploys to eu-west? I don't see rollouts in last 2 hours.
anne_support: 3 customers opened chats complaining about slow responses, no errors yet. tagging product for visibility @liam_prod
liam_prod: thx. are we seeing user-facing errors or just latency? need quick mitigation plan.
maria_sre: mostly latency. tail tokens slow. p95 distribution shifted — looks like some requests hitting large sequence lengths, combined with small batch sizes. Could be batching hysteresis + cache misses.
oncall-uk: good hypothesis. immediate mitigations: 1) scale tokenizer sidecar replicas x2 2) reduce max_batch_wait from 15ms -> 5ms 3) enable fallthrough to small-model-rc for non-critical routes. which can we do now?
jaxon-eng: I can scale-sidecar quickly: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/tokenizer-eu --replicas=6` — doing it now.
incident-bot: action recorded: runbook "latency-tail-burn" step=scale_tokenizer by jaxon-eng
anne_support: I'll patch the support notes: "We are investigating latency in eu-west, working on mitigation. No data loss." :memo:
maria_sre: decreasing max_batch_wait is risky but should lower tail. jaxon please also increase KV cache TTL on the hot path: `curl -XPOST http://kvcache-config/eu/set?ttl=120` or use the config rollout.
jaxon-eng: kv ttl change applied (unvalidated). scaling done. rolling restart for sidecar to pick config: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/tokenizer-eu` — kicked.
liam_prod: enabling fallback to smaller model for web-search route in 30s. Will flip traffic to model-small-v2 by config toggle.
oncall-uk: toggle done via configservice, traffic shift ~20% now, monitor.
maria_sre: telemetry: p95 dropped to 310ms after scale+fallback, p99 down to 1.4s. SLO burn -> 4% (last 5m). still above target but improving.
anne_support: customers updated in chat, one user said response time feels better now. keeping watch.
jaxon-eng: rolling restart completed, sidecars report healthy. KV cache miss rate dropped ~60%.
oncall-uk: ok owners: jaxon-eng owns infra actions, maria_sre owns telemetry and rollback criteria, anne_support owning customer comms, liam_prod owns routing/fallback. If improvement holds for 10m we'll close pager.
maria_sre: setting alert suppression window +10m to avoid autopager flapping while we stabilize.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident 3112024321 acknowledged by oncall-uk. Suppression applied.
liam_prod: quick postmortem note: follow-up items — investigate cause of sudden large-sequence traffic, consider KV prewarming and autoscaler tuning.
oncall-uk: handing to overnight oncall: @maria_sre will keep watch for next 30m and then transfer to eu-night. If SLO burn <1% for 15m we'll resolve.
maria_sre: will monitor. ping me if anything re-escalates. :lock:
anne_support: closing live customer updates after next check-in.
incident-bot: Activity log updated. Next check-in scheduled in 10 minutes.
oncall-uk: thanks team. marking this thread as in-mitigation. continuing watch and will update final status in 25m.
